name: Gate
description: The principle of the transistor. A thin strip of lightly doped silicon carries a current from the drain, held at 10, to the grounded source. Two gate electrodes beside it, on your supply, never touch it: a negative gate pushes the strip's carriers out and the current fades, until none flows; a positive one draws more in from the contacts. Set the gate so that between 0.08 and 0.16 flows into the drain, a third to two thirds of what flows with the gate at 0 (averaged over $t = 20$ to $60$). A metal screens any field within an atom, so no gate reaches inside copper; billions of these gates, each over a thin oxide on a silicon channel, switch in every chip.

reality.represents: A field-effect transistor: a junctionless, depletion-mode FET

remarks.detail: A gate beside a channel a few screening lengths thin empties it (depletion) or fills it from the contacts (accumulation), and the current follows: what a metal, screening within an atom, can never do.

Depletion, accumulation, pinch-off, the current's saturation at high drain voltage, the current over the gate's barrier below threshold and the channel's charging all come out of the carriers' motion in the fields.

Only electrons: no holes, no generation or recombination. A MOSFET's inversion layer and the pn junctions at its source and drain cannot form, so this is a uniformly doped, normally-on channel that the gate depletes: a junctionless (depletion-mode) transistor, not an enhancement-mode MOSFET.

The gate faces the channel across empty space, and the permittivity is 1 everywhere (silicon's is 11.7, its oxide's 3.9). No work-function difference (gate 0 is flat band), no oxide or interface charge, no traps, no gate leakage.

remarks.line: Simple collisions, a lattice that never warms
remarks.detail: The carriers bounce off random hard discs, not phonons and impurities: there is no saturation velocity (at high fields the drift keeps growing, about as √E), and the device never heats itself.
The donors are a uniform positive background, always fully ionized: they scatter nothing, and there are no random dopant fluctuations.
No band structure, no quantum confinement in the thin channel, no tunnelling. The classical Boltzmann statistics is right at this light doping.

remarks.line: A slice of an infinitely wide device
remarks.detail: The device is infinitely wide along z (the usual cut in device simulation), but each carrier is a line of charge moving as one: its noise and grainy field are far larger than a real device's, why the current deep below threshold is not converged.
kT/q is 4 here, so the gate at −18 is 4.5 kT/q, about 0.12 V at room temperature; a real gate swings about 1 V, 40 kT/q. The channel matches n-type silicon at about 10¹⁶ per cm³ by its own ratios.
The source and drain are perfect reservoirs of the channel's own doping; real ones are heavily doped regions with a resistance of their own.
